{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter: completed orders, exclude QA and refunded
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute raw average revenue per channel (unadjusted)
raw_avg = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().reset_index()
raw_avg = raw_avg.rename(columns={'revenue': 'raw_avg_revenue'})

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue within each group
stratified_avg = completed_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().reset_index()

# Compute the proportion of each segment within each channel
channel_segment_prop = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True).reset_index(name='prop')

# Merge proportion into stratified averages
stratified_avg = stratified_avg.merge(channel_segment_prop, on=['channel', 'customer_segment'])

# Compute adjusted average revenue per channel: weighted by segment proportion
adjusted_avg = stratified_avg.groupby('channel').apply(
    lambda x: (x['revenue'] * x['prop']).sum()
).reset_index(name='adjusted_revenue')

# Compute the difference: email - paid_search
email_revenue = adjusted_avg[adjusted_avg['channel'] == 'email']['adjusted_revenue'].values[0]
paid_search_revenue = adjusted_avg[adjusted_avg['channel'] == 'paid_search']['adjusted_revenue'].values[0]
difference = email_revenue - paid_search_revenue

# Print all key results
print("Raw average revenue per channel:")
print(raw_avg)

print("\nStratified average revenue per channel by customer_segment:")
print(stratified_avg)

print("\nAdjusted average revenue per channel:")
print(adjusted_avg)

print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
